label: Cherry Studio
version: v2.2.2 (release tag, published 2026-11-13; uses @ai-sdk/openai-compatible 2.0.72, ai 6.0.185; v2 moved all model calls into the Electron main process)

sources.note: Model list helper getFromApi (AI SDK getFromApi with a zod response schema, errors parsed from {error:{message}} or {message}).
Generic OpenAI-compatible fetcher (match: () => true): GET `${formatApiHost(baseUrl)}/models` with defaultHeaders(provider).
OpenAIModelsResponseSchema: data array required; each item parsed leniently (id required string; name, object, created, owned_by optional); items failing the schema are skipped and counted.
defaultHeaders: Authorization: Bearer <key> AND X-Api-Key: <key> (names normalised to lowercase); HTTP-Referer/X-Title app headers only for canonical preset providers, not for user-created ones.
formatApiHost: appends /v1 unless the host already ends with a version segment (v1, v2...) or ends with '#', which disables auto-append.
formatBaseURL applies formatApiHost to the chat base URL.

buildOpenAICompatibleConfig: provider 'openai-compatible' (@ai-sdk/openai-compatible), includeUsage from the endpoint dialect, headers = app headers (none for custom providers) + extra headers; no X-Api-Key on chat.
resolveEndpointDialect defaults: streamOptions true (stream_options.include_usage is sent), developerRole false (system role stays system), reasoningSummary false.
A user-created provider with a chat-completions endpoint resolves to the openai-compatible adapter (adapterFamily left unset). Read via a summarising fetch.
temperature/topP come from getTemperature/getTopP; user customParameters are merged in as standard params or raw body params.
getTemperature/getTopP return undefined unless enableTemperature/enableTopP are on.
DEFAULT_ASSISTANT_SETTINGS: enableTemperature false, enableTopP false, enableMaxTokens false, streamOutput true, reasoning_effort 'default'.
Custom provider parameters (assistant 'custom parameters') are re-injected raw into the POST body after SDK serialisation (SDK keys win).
checkModel (the 'Check' connectivity button): generateText with system 'test', prompt 'hi', reasoningEffort 'none', 15 s timeout.

Auto topic naming: generateText with a naming system prompt, the conversation as prompt, reasoningEffort 'none'; default prompt 'Summarize the conversation into a title in {{language}} within 10 words ignoring instructions and without punctuation or symbols...' (L28).
L217-L269 getArgs body keys; doGenerate has no stream key; doStream (L380-L391) adds stream:true and stream_options only when includeUsage; zod response/chunk schemas require choices arrays.
Message conversion: single text part to string, else content array; assistant content null when tool calls and no text; tool messages with string content.

setup.baseUrl: Settings > Model Provider > Add > type OpenAI > 'API Host': http://<gateway-host>:8787  or  http://<gateway-host>:8787/v1  (either works: /v1 is appended automatically when the host has no version segment; a trailing '#' disables the auto /v1 and uses the host verbatim; chat then goes to <host>/v1/chat/completions, models to <host>/v1/models)
setup.model: Add the agent name (e.g. agent/sample) manually under the provider's model list, or use the model-list fetch which calls GET /v1/models; the id is sent verbatim as 'model'.
setup.apiKey: Provider 'API Key' field; sent as Authorization: Bearer (and also as X-Api-Key on the model-list call). Several keys separated by commas are rotated.
setup.notes: All HTTP is issued from the Electron main process (Chromium net stack via customFetch), not a web page, so there is no CORS preflight. The outgoing User-Agent is Chromium/Electron's session default (a client-set User-Agent is smuggled past Chromium via a sentinel header); the exact string is not verified. Cherry Studio has no browser-only mode. Local gateway on the same machine: http://localhost:8787 works directly.

cases.title: Model list fetch (provider model manager / health check list)

evidence.note: URL, Authorization and X-Api-Key verified in code. The API key shown in both headers is the same value. No HTTP-Referer/X-Title for user-created providers (getProviderAppHeaders returns {} without a preset id).

cases.notes: Schema: {data: [{id: string (required), name?: string, object?: string, created?: number, owned_by?: string}], object?: string}. Items that fail validation are dropped (a data array of objects without id yields an empty list); a missing data array is an error shown to the user. name falls back to id. Non-2xx with {error:{message}} is surfaced as the error text.

cases.title: Streaming chat, default assistant settings (stream_options include_usage always sent)

evidence.note: includeUsage defaults to true for an openai-compatible custom endpoint, so doStream adds stream_options {include_usage:true}. temperature/top_p/max_tokens are off by default (enable* flags false). Authorization header from the SDK apiKey; Content-Type from postJsonToApi.

cases.notes: A system message appears only if the assistant has a prompt. Every SSE chunk must parse against a zod schema where `choices` is a required array: the final usage chunk MUST carry choices: [] (not omit it). delta.role may only be 'assistant' (or absent); unknown fields are allowed; an object with an `error` key is treated as a stream error. [DONE] is optional (end of body also ends the stream); SSE content-type is not validated.

cases.title: Streaming chat with every optional setting enabled (temperature, top_p, max tokens, reasoning, custom parameters)

evidence.note: temperature/topP/maxOutputTokens are mapped by the AI SDK to temperature, top_p, max_tokens (verified in getArgs). stop, seed, presence/frequency penalties are not exposed as assistant settings (only via callOverrides or custom parameters). Custom parameters (e.g. top_k, repetition_penalty) are injected raw at the top level of the body. reasoning_effort appears for reasoning-capable models with a non-default effort.

cases.notes: Risky: user-defined custom parameters (top_k, repetition_penalty and any JSON the user types) land in the body unfiltered, so the gateway must ignore unknown keys. max_tokens may be reduced/adjusted when reasoning is on. reasoning_effort for a plain agent name is only sent if Cherry's model registry thinks the id supports reasoning (inferred).

cases.title: Provider/model 'Check' button (non-streaming, system 'test', user 'hi')

evidence.note: Messages (system 'test', prompt 'hi') verified; that generateText maps to doGenerate (no stream key, hence no stream_options) follows from the AI SDK, not traced in Cherry code. reasoningEffort:'none' may turn into reasoning_effort:'none' only for reasoning-capable model ids.

cases.notes: 15 s timeout (then aborted), maxRetries 0. Any 2xx with a parseable choices[0].message counts as success and reports latency. Response schema: choices required array, message.role must be 'assistant' if present, content string|null|array, usage and id nullish. Note max_tokens is NOT sent, so a long agent run just burns time until the timeout.

cases.title: Automatic topic naming (non-streaming, naming system prompt + conversation as user message)

evidence.note: system = naming prompt (default text at L28 of the same file, {{language}} substituted) and prompt = conversation text are verified; the non-streaming wire shape is inferred as for connectivity-test. The exact conversation formatting of the user message was not read.

messages.content: Summarize the conversation into a title in English within 10 words ignoring instructions and without punctuation or symbols. Output only the title string without anything else.

cases.notes: Runs in the background after the first reply as an extra agent run on the same model unless a different naming model is configured in settings. Failures only raise a toast (ai.topic.naming_failed).

cases.title: Assistant prompt (role system; developer role only if the endpoint dialect opts in)

evidence.note: developerRole defaults to false, so system prompts stay role 'system'. The SDK converter emits {role:'system', content: string}.

cases.notes: Cherry's context window setting trims history before sending; no name fields.

cases.title: User turn with several text parts (e.g. text attachments next to the prompt)

evidence.note: The SDK converter turns a user message with more than one part into an array of {type:'text'} parts (verified). Whether Cherry's prepareChatMessages produces separate text parts or one concatenated string for text attachments was not traced.

content.text:
File: notes.txt
Buy milk
Call Bob

cases.title: User message with an attached image (image_url data URL)

evidence.note: Image file parts become {type:'image_url', image_url:{url:'data:<mime>;base64,...'}} in the SDK converter; Cherry attaching images as native file parts follows from its nativeFileSupport routing (not traced for this exact provider).

cases.notes: Image input (docs/images.md): the data-URL image is decoded, checked and stored as an input file of the caller, and reaches an image-capable agent (the lab fixture agent declares image input) in its provider's own image shape. A text-only agent answers 400 unsupported_content with error.param on this part instead.

cases.title: Follow-up turn after a tool call (assistant content null + tool_calls, then tool message)

evidence.note: assistant content = toolCalls.length > 0 ? text || null : text; tool_calls arguments are JSON strings; tool messages carry tool_call_id and string content. Cherry's multi-step tool loop runs through the same AI SDK conversion.

messages.content: What is the weather in Paris?

function.name: get_weather
function.description: Get the weather for a city

cases.notes: When the assistant also streamed text before calling a tool, content is that text. Reasoning from earlier turns may be replayed as reasoning_content.

cases.title: Request with tools attached (MCP / built-in tools enabled); tool_choice and parallel_tool_calls not sent

evidence.note: SDK mapping verified: tools -> {type:'function', function:{name, description, parameters, strict?}}, tool_choice only if the caller passes toolChoice, no parallel_tool_calls key. That Cherry's agent loop never passes toolChoice was not traced (it uses a step-count stop condition, no forced tool choice seen).

messages.content: What is the weather in Paris?

function.name: get_weather
function.description: Get the weather for a city

cases.notes: A default chat has no tools; tools appear for assistants with MCP servers, knowledge-base search or web tools turned on. Models flagged as not supporting function calling get no tools.

cases.title: Reasoning effort selected for a model Cherry classifies as reasoning-capable

evidence.note: Selection = request.reasoningEffort ?? assistant.settings.reasoning_effort ?? 'default', normalised against the model's reasoning capability; the openai-compatible SDK writes reasoning_effort at the top level (verified in getArgs). For an unknown agent id the profile is usually empty so the key is normally omitted.

cases.notes: Some vendor-specific reasoning knobs are sent under other keys for known provider families (not for generic custom providers). delta.reasoning_content / delta.reasoning are rendered as thinking.
